For the next two evenings—**Thursday, October 1** and **Friday, October 2**—my two complementary picks are:

| Occasion | Restaurant | Likely cost | Why it fits | Reservation check |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| **Client/business dinner** | **Grill 23 & Bar** — 161 Berkeley St, Back Bay | **About $150–$300+ per person before tax/tip**, depending especially on wine and steak selection; comfortably within your ~$500 target unless you choose the highest-end Wagyu/caviar. | A classic, formal Boston steakhouse with steak, raw-bar and seafood options, polished service, private-dining capability, and a Grand Award-winning wine list—very safe for a client dinner. Current dinner menu examples: steak frites $48, prime New York $79, dry-aged ribeye $98, filet $84, seafood entrées $55, and A5 Wagyu $180. | It is open Thu **5–10 PM** and Fri **5–10:30 PM**, and its site/Google listing offer reservations. Its booking provider’s live page was blocked to this browser, so I **could not truthfully confirm a specific time**. This is the stronger business choice; try Thu first, preferably roughly 7–8 PM. Phone: **617-542-2255**. |
| **Anniversary** | **Mare Oyster Bar** — 223 Hanover St / 3 Mechanic St, North End | **About $90–$175 per person before tax/tip** for pasta/seafood, dessert, and drinks; higher with a raw-bar tower or premium wine. | This is precisely the requested Italian-seafood/Boston combination: a modern Italian seafood restaurant and oyster bar in the North End. The North End setting and seafood-forward menu make it much more intimate and celebratory than the steakhouse. Current menu includes black squid linguine & clams $31.99, homemade gnocchi frutti di mare $34.99, lobster ravioli $33.99, and tableside cacio e pepe $39.99. | Mare is currently listed as **5–11 PM** on both evenings and directs guests to **OpenTable** for reservations. OpenTable also blocked its live inventory to this browser, so **availability remains unconfirmed**, rather than presumed. It is nevertheless the clearly suitable anniversary booking—request the patio/fire-pit area if offered. Phone: **617-723-6273**. |

**Recommendation:** Book **Grill 23 on Thursday** for the work/client evening and **Mare on Friday** for the anniversary. Both have active reservation routes, but I was unable to see real-time slots because OpenTable denied automated browser access; calling is the most direct confirmation route, particularly for your preferred dinner time.

I left the restaurants’ official pages open for you: Grill 23’s home/menu pages and Mare’s home, reservation, menu, and pasta-menu pages. The Google Maps pages for each are also open for photos and location details.

I’m in Boston with my wife for the next two evenings on a work trip, and I’d like help choosing and checking two quite different dinner reservations. One should be polished enough for a client or business dinner—fine dining, but preferably no more than about $500 per person. The other is for our anniversary, so I’d like something genuinely romantic, ideally Italian seafood or a distinctly Boston experience.

Please check current restaurant information and availability over the next two days, rather than relying on reviews alone. I’d appreciate a concise comparison with likely cost, why each fits the occasion, and whether either appears to have a suitable reservation. Please keep the restaurant pages open at the end so I can examine the menu, photos, and booking details myself.

R1.reason: Grill 23’s official home and menu pages remain open and support its polished steakhouse/private-dining positioning and menu prices, while the response gives a $150–$300+ estimate within the $500 ceiling.

R2.reason: Although Mare’s official and Google Maps pages are open, the only OpenTable page for Mare is an Access Denied page rather than a usable OpenTable listing showing cuisine and romantic/special-occasion cues, and the user did not specify OpenTable.

R3.reason: Grill 23 official menu/home pages and a date-specific Resy booking page are open, and the response states both the expected price range and that live availability for the next two days could not be confirmed.

R4.reason: Mare’s official menu, reservation, and Maps pages support its Italian-seafood identity and price discussion, but the agent did not provide or leave verifiable special-occasion/romantic evidence or a confirmed next-two-days availability result.
